hypothesis: RVL trainer snapshot/restore omits per-module training flags. An exception after a real optimizer mutation can restore weights, optimizer, and RNG while leaving modules in changed training modes.
primary_test_checks: root eval mode with a nested MLP subtree in train mode before snapshot
actual HFCausalLMGRPOTrainer.train_step and AdamW optimizer mutation before an injected exception
parameter, nonempty optimizer state, and RNG state have changed before restore
all model tensors, all optimizer state, CPU RNG, and every named module training flag exactly match the pre-update snapshot after restore
legacy_test_checks: snapshot with module_modes removed restores model tensors, populated optimizer state, and CPU RNG

acceptance.base_test_only_result: mixed-mode exception regression fails; legacy snapshot control passes
acceptance.model: randomly initialized tiny GPT-2; no downloads

claim_boundary: Correctness of per-module mode restoration and preservation of existing model/optimizer/CPU-RNG rollback on a tiny CPU fixture. Does not establish production incidence, default-Qwen path behavior change, pretrained-model effect, model capability gain, upstream adoption, or independent external review.
